name: – Marjan Šarec – § 1 – Am 3
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Montenegro
part_text: 1. Welcomes Montenegro’s steady progress on EU-related reforms, underpinned by broad political engagement and ambition to complete negotiations by the end of 2026; welcomes the provisional closure of 6 more negotiating chapters in 2025 and 2 in 2026, bringing the total to 14; reiterates its full support for the country’s future in the EU; welcomes the establishment in the Council of an ad hoc working group on the drafting of an accession treaty with Montenegro, as an important and timely step in advancing the final phase of Montenegro’s EU accession process and reaffirming the EU’s commitment to enlargement;
